body:
PR117's saved native Farkas vector had exact nonzero weighted coefficients on 1,589 truly free columns, so its full bound support was unbounded. This repair retains the original native LP and every inequality multiplier, derives equality multipliers by exact rational reverse triangular substitution, and independently proves finite support, source separation and outward rounding on the original matrix. The raw floating rays remain rejected; no residual is clamped, sign-flipped or deleted.

The isolated run reused PR117's exact saved 85,744-bit x0 and ordered axis. Native x0 recourse was INFEASIBLE in 1367.159 s (Kappa 7.81611e15); its completed rational Farkas certificate produced validated cut #1. Only then did the one-thread master create and atomically save distinct x1 (321 changed bits, first-cut value +190.767543). Native x1 recourse was INFEASIBLE in 1031.127 s (Kappa 3.81613e15), and a second completed certificate passed independent validation and insertion replay. Both cuts also passed bit-exact master API transport checks. Phase-I was NOT_RUN. All raw journals, warnings, candidate hashes and source provenance are retained.

The minimum pilot and its additional second-cut goal are complete: 2 certified cuts, 2 distinct saved candidates, 0 uncertified cuts. B3 is still INCONCLUSIVE; full B3 and original M1 canary were NOT_RUN under this isolated preregistration. Production M1/P2/A2/M2 were explicitly excluded. P1_ACCEPTED, M1_ACCEPTED and PROBLEM13_FINAL_VALIDATED remain false. Original M1 UB/LB stay 0.5912812634331275 / 0.5722125039436496 (gap 3.224989640%). No causal runtime or Kappa improvement is claimed.

Validation: exact base e2d4779685fff6d0cf022c649733b2ca41fdfc08; all 2,121 inherited tracked files and 44 bounded-check evidence preserved. All 1,536 inherited assignments (49 feasible / 1,487 infeasible), N1-N10 and a reduced free-support reproducer passed; native/identity/fixed power-of-two fixture classifications and optima agree, with 4,459 independently replayed fixture certificates. All 850 tests pass (825 inherited + 25 new; one inherited calibration warning). Scientific MPS/snapshot comparison, source freeze, raw journal/candidate lineage, staged Git manifests and diff checks pass. The initial missing-cache preflight failure is preserved alongside the restored-cache PASS record. Evidence and 60 Korean Q&A are in docs/v42_m1_benders_x0_certificate_repair/.
title: V42 M1: exact x0 certificate repair and two validated Benders cuts
